title: DrawL: Understanding the Effects of Non-Mainstream Dialects in Prompted Image Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting a text-to-image model with minimally contrastive pairs of sentences written in Mainstream American English (MAE) and African American English (AAE) to observe changes in the generated images.
Using the Monk Skin Tone (MST) scale and an automated classifier to measure and compare the distribution of skin tones in images generated from MAE versus AAE prompts.

Evaluating intersectional effects by explicitly specifying male, female, or unspecified genders in the prompts to analyze if the model's sensitivity to dialect and skin tone varies across gender categories.
